what: A single photo covering the screen shrinks into a centered 55rem square over 1.2s, delayed .2s, the moment the section head touches the top edge of the screen, and vanishes at .6s after 1.1s. Beneath it, four large and small photo panels stacked at the center scatter to the four corners (top right · bottom right · bottom left · top left) over 1.2s, delayed .6s, unfolding a collage. Curve cubic-bezier(.55,.05,.22,.99), once. If displace-mix-gl is attached inside the scattered panels, each panel’s photo ripples and changes every 3 seconds

options.at: “enter” means at the 15% line from the bottom of the screen — the default is when the section top touches the top of the screen
options.--fx-size: Square size the cover shrinks to, default 55rem
options.--w: Width per panel (% of stage width), default alternating 26% and 32%, center 48.7%
options.[data-fx-part=tile]: Panels to scatter — four in order: top right, bottom right, bottom left, top left
options.[data-fx-part=center]: (If present) large center panel left over

note: The original stands this panel with sticky inside a 200svh-tall box so the spread-out collage stays for one screen — the consuming side wraps it. Sends fx:open when it opens

from.where: index.html ‹And it turns› section · about.html Hero (original .p-top-around__intro / .p-mawaru-around__intro — op .img 1.2s .2s · op .6s 1.1s · item 1.2s .6s)
